scores.evidence: Phase 1 "Secrets integration (load-bearing: every subsequent step depends on this)" → RBAC → approval gates; Phase 2 depends on V0, V3, V4
scores.rationale: Phases run substrate → secrets/RBAC → promotion → prod with gates proving dependencies first, though a few gate/phase labels are inconsistent (V1, V2 scheduling).

scores.evidence: Developer pushes to a Git branch → webhook fires → agent pulls code → ... → pod created in a test namespace → rollback deletes the pod
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end push-to-deploy-to-rollback path with exit checks, though in a test namespace rather than true prod.

scores.evidence: Hosted vs. self-hosted | R3 | Default: Hosted ... Flip: Self-hosted if total hosted cost >$X/month, or on-premise compliance mandate
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are tabled with default, validation, and explicit flip conditions, placed up front.

scores.evidence: Tasks (by blast radius): 1. Secrets integration (load-bearing...) 2. RBAC... ; exposure: pilot 3 services, then 5, 15, 20
scores.rationale: Tasks within phases are ordered widest-impact first and rollout exposure smallest first.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: Agent runs in isolated container; no host-mounted secrets; credentials injected at runtime (test creds only, minimal scope).
scores.rationale: Security has concrete treatment in every phase from 0 through 3, though Phase 0 admits cluster-admin agents.

scores.evidence: Structured JSON; every log entry tagged with deployment_id, service_name, phase; metrics build_time, test_time, deploy_time, pod startup
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in every subsequent phase.

scores.evidence: Build is deterministic: same code → same image SHA. Rollback is tested ... RBAC config stored in Git; manifests in Kustomize/Helm
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is addressed concretely in each phase (deterministic builds, config in Git, traceable deploys).

scores.evidence: Phase 1: Vault HA: 3-node cluster; Phase 2: agent pool 3+ agents, job queue, logs replicated to 2 sinks; Phase 0: logs to sink immediately
scores.rationale: Failure handling and rollback appear in every phase, including Phase 0 liveness and log durability.

scores.evidence: N/A — no AI component. The CI/CD platform is deterministic software ... without LLM inference, retrieval augmentation, or agentic decision-making.
scores.rationale: Plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Multi-region / multi-cloud support — Not built in Phases 0–3. Pull-forward condition: Post-Phase 3; if org expands to multiple regions or clouds
scores.rationale: Five deferred items each with explicit pull-forward conditions.

note: Strong, thorough plan satisfying all dimensions; minor inconsistencies (gate numbering and scheduling, V11 reused for two things, cluster-admin in Phase 0) and the test-namespace skeleton don't materially undermine it.
